warnings: House title block: '(002... series design not printed on structural sheets themselves, but architectural cover title block reads 'งามพิศ 2' — part of the 'แบบบ้านยิ้มเพื่อประชาชน' series by สำนักการโยธา กรุงเทพมหานคร, same series as houses already in the dataset (09/12/14/16/18/19/20 - this is now this series' entry for 'บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_20'). Single-bay 2-storey house, 3x6 main grid (3 columns x 5 rows + 1 dummy row B') with a full X-shaped hip roof (steel purlins/rafters) and an octagonal bay window on grid line 3.

Row 'B\'' is printed WITH its prime directly on the source drawing (its own circled label on the dimension chain, page หน้า18/หน้า19, exactly like A/B/C/D/E) — treated as type 'named' rather than 'dummy' because it is not a line we derived ourselves, it is the architect's own printed grid line. It carries no footing (หน้า17's footing plan skips straight from B to C with a combined 4.00 m span) — a column (marked 'CA' at grid1, a special column landing directly on a beam per the sheet's own legend 'เสา CA เสริมพิเศษบนคาน') sits at B'1 without its own footing. Recorded under z_levels/columns accordingly; see หน้า17/18/19 files.

Numerous small per-bay slab-top offsets (+0.10/+0.30/+0.35/+0.40/+0.45/+0.50 on the ground floor; +2.10/+3.45/+3.65/+3.75 on the upper floor/roof) are printed throughout the beam plans next to each bay. These are LOCAL slab-top elevations relative to each floor's structural framing level, not building-wide storey levels, so they were NOT promoted into z_levels[] — they are recorded as the 'level' annotation on each beam/slab element instead, matching how the mark is printed (e.g. 'B2(+0.40)').

The roof plan (หน้า19/หน้า20) prints a second set of x-axis offsets under each main span (e.g. 1.90/1.10 splitting the 1-2 span, 1.10/2.40 splitting the 2-3 span, plus edge offsets 1.00/1.10 before grid1 and 0.60/0.30 after grid3) describing the projecting roof-overhang/eave edge and a recessed porch-canopy edge, not additional structural grid lines — no beam or column endpoint was found landing on these split points (RB2, the only beam at that row, spans plain grid1-grid2 and grid2-grid3). Per the beam-endpoint rule (§4) no dummy grid was added for them; recorded in unassigned_dimensions instead.

'-288.33 ▽+3650 ระดับหลังอะเสเหล็ก' on หน้า12: the '-288.33' figure reads as CAD/scale artifact text bleeding through the scan, not a real printed dimension (no consistent unit or context ties it to anything else on the sheet) — the level value itself (+3.650, 'ระดับหลังอะเสเหล็ก', the lower steel eave-beam level over the ground-floor porch/kitchen roof) is genuine and kept in z_levels; the '-288.33' text was NOT recorded anywhere.

The secondary ridge level on หน้า13 (Section B-B) is printed as '▽+8654' with no clearly legible Thai label in the scan (the main ridge on หน้า12/Section A-A IS clearly labelled 'ระดับหลังอกไก่นอนใหญ่' = 7.789). Recorded +8.654 in z_levels with id=null and a confidence_flag rather than guessing a label.
